claim.normalised_claim: Electric vehicles constitute 18% of all new car sales globally.

elements.description: The total number of new cars sold globally is recorded.
The total number of new electric vehicles sold globally is recorded.
The ratio of new electric vehicle sales to total new car sales is calculated.
This calculated ratio is equal to 18%.
